C-KERNEL-OPERABILITY-COMPATIBILITY-UPGRA.Title: Operability, Compatibility and Upgrade v1: Stable Contracts, Staged Plugin Update, Rollback, Safe Mode, Diagnostics and Chaos Hardening

Constraints.Constraint: UPGRADE IS A TRANSACTIONAL STATE TRANSITION, NOT "REPLACE SOME FILES".
INSTALLATION IDENTITY DOES NOT CHANGE MERELY BECAUSE PACKAGE VERSION CHANGES.
PACKAGE REVISION, INSTALLATION IDENTITY AND RUNTIME IDENTITY ARE THREE DISTINCT CONCEPTS.
A STAGED VERSION HAS NO ACTIVE PROVIDER AUTHORITY BEFORE SWITCH.
MIGRATION RUNS AGAINST STAGED/COPIED STATE BEFORE ACTIVE STATE IS IRREVERSIBLY REPLACED.
FAILED HEALTH VALIDATION MUST NOT REPLACE THE LAST KNOWN GOOD REVISION.
ROLLBACK RESTORES A PREVIOUSLY VALIDATED REVISION, NOT AN ASSUMED VERSION.
CRASH RECOVERY RECONSTRUCTS EXACTLY ONE AUTHORITATIVE CURRENT REVISION.
SAFE MODE REDUCES COMPOSITION; IT DOES NOT BYPASS AUTHORIZATION.
OPERATIONAL METRICS DO NOT CONTAIN RAW PRIVATE RPC/EVENT/STATE PAYLOAD.
UNKNOWN EXTERNAL SIDE EFFECT OUTCOME IS INCOMPLETE, NEVER SYNTHETIC SUCCESS OR FAILURE.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Fresh local evidence proves contract stability rules, staged migration on copy, health validation, atomic switch, rollback, quarantine, safe mode, bisect, telemetry, diagnostics, and process-kill chaos matrix pass without raw payload leakage or authority inheritance.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Stable compatible minor provider works with unchanged consumer.
Stable incompatible major is rejected before activation.
Experimental unsupported revision is rejected explicitly.
SDK N/N-1/N-2 designated fixtures pass supported current kernel matrix.
Staged revision has no provider publication before switch.
Failed migration-on-copy preserves current state and revision.
Failed health validation preserves current revision.
Successful staged update atomically changes active package revision.
New revision receives fresh RuntimeId and inherits no old runtime grants.
Rollback restores last-known-good package/state without stale authority.
Repeated broken optional plugin enters quarantine and does not auto-activate.
Safe mode boots without quarantined/optional plugins and enforces authorization.
Automated bisect identifies single deterministic offending optional plugin.
Runtime metrics observe activation/crash/denial/mailbox without raw payload.
Correlation diagnostic reconstructs known causal chain and flags gaps.
Side-effect outcome becomes Incomplete on crash and unsafe operations are not retried.

C-KERNEL-OPERABILITY-COMPATIBILITY-UPGRA.Summary:
Закрыть M0 созданием эксплуатационного contract для уже существующей plugin platform Worldline.
После этого change Worldline должен уметь не только запускать, изолировать и восстанавливать plugins, но и безопасно жить во времени:
- определять, совместимы ли kernel/SDK/plugin contracts; - отклонять несовместимый upgrade ДО switch; - staging нового plugin/package/runtime отдельно от current active version; - мигрировать state на копии; - проверять health staged version; - атомарно переключать active installation/package revision; - откатываться к предыдущей working revision; - локализовать broken plugin через quarantine/safe mode; - автоматически находить offending plugin/revision bounded bisect; - показывать причинную цепочку failure через correlation/causation; - сохранять явный Incomplete outcome там, где crash делает внешний side effect недоказуемым.
M0.7 также превращает существующие tests в систематическую hardening matrix:
compatibility/property/fuzz/negative-security/process-kill chaos.
Главный proving scenario:
working composition -> staged incompatible/broken update -> incompatibility или health failure обнаружена до switch -> previous revision продолжает работать
И отдельно:
compatible staged update -> migration on copy -> health validation -> atomic switch -> post-switch failure -> rollback -> previous state/package restored -> unrelated runtimes продолжают работать.
M0.7 НЕ реализует browser product UX. Safe mode/degraded shell на этом milestone означает generic host/runtime composition state и diagnostic/control surface; M1 позже даст этому пользовательскую UI surface.

Preconditions.Precondition: M0.6 — Stable IPC and WASM Component Boundary — Done.

RoadmapAlignment.Postcondition: Успешное завершение M0.7 закрывает M0 и открывает M1.1 — Browser Contract and Engine Spike.

ArchitecturalInvariants.Invariant: UPGRADE IS A TRANSACTIONAL STATE TRANSITION, NOT "REPLACE SOME FILES".
INSTALLATION IDENTITY DOES NOT CHANGE MERELY BECAUSE PACKAGE VERSION CHANGES.
PACKAGE REVISION, INSTALLATION IDENTITY AND RUNTIME IDENTITY ARE DISTINCT.
A STAGED VERSION HAS NO ACTIVE PROVIDER AUTHORITY BEFORE SWITCH.
MIGRATION RUNS AGAINST STAGED/COPIED STATE BEFORE ACTIVE STATE IS IRREVERSIBLY REPLACED.
FAILED HEALTH VALIDATION MUST NOT REPLACE THE LAST KNOWN GOOD REVISION.
ROLLBACK RESTORES A PREVIOUSLY VALIDATED REVISION, NOT AN ASSUMED VERSION.
CONTRACT COMPATIBILITY IS DETERMINISTIC AND MACHINE-CHECKABLE.
STABLE AND EXPERIMENTAL CONTRACTS HAVE DIFFERENT COMPATIBILITY PROMISES.
A BROKEN OPTIONAL PLUGIN MUST NOT DESTROY AN INDEPENDENT CAPABILITY SUBGRAPH.

Goals.Goal: Зафиксировать compatibility policy для capability/API/package contracts.
Ввести Stable и Experimental lifecycle для contracts.
Реализовать generic safe mode и persistent quarantine.
Добавить resolver property testing, fuzzing, negative-security и process-kill chaos suites.
Формализовать Incomplete для side effects с неизвестным crash outcome.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Event-source conversion of existing state domains.

RequiredADR.Requirement: Cordis-rs lifecycle/effect ownership remains architectural lineage, but ADR explicitly records that Worldline upgrade/compatibility, process/WASM isolation, persistent revision identity and rollback semantics are stronger contracts rather than inherited Cordis-rs behavior.

ContractStability.Invariant: Stability class is metadata of a contract version line, not of a provider implementation.
Provider cannot self-declare a Stable incompatible implementation and thereby force acceptance.

CompatibilityRules.StableMajor: Different major versions are incompatible unless an explicit adapter contract exists.
CompatibilityRules.StableMinor: Minor evolution may add backward-compatible optional semantics according to declared negotiation rules.
CompatibilityRules.Patch: Patch does not intentionally change public semantics.
CompatibilityRules.Requirement: Compatibility is evaluated from machine-readable contract metadata.
No compatibility decision is based on package filename, plugin name prefix or lexical version guessing.

CompatibilityMatrix.RequiredMatrix:
current kernel vs SDK N current kernel vs SDK N-1 current kernel vs SDK N-2
current SDK vs each currently supported kernel baseline
CompatibilityMatrix.Clarification: N/N-1/N-2 guarantee initially applies to designated Stable SDK/contract fixtures, not every experimental internal interface.
CompatibilityMatrix.Requirement: Repository keeps versioned compatibility fixtures/golden packages.
CI executes old fixture artifacts rather than recompiling every old SDK fixture against current sources where that would erase ABI/protocol evidence.
Unsupported version produces explicit CompatibilityRejected before runtime provider publication.

PackageRevisionModel.Rule: InstallationId remains stable across compatible package updates.
PackageRevisionId identifies immutable installed artifact revision.
Every successful activation records exact package digest/revision.
RuntimeId always belongs to exactly one InstallationRevision.
A rollback creates a fresh RuntimeId for the restored revision.

UpgradeStateMachine.Invariant: Only one revision is authoritative Current for an InstallationId.
Staging does not mutate current package artifact.
Failed staged revision is never silently promoted.

MigrationOnCopy.Requirement: State migration for upgrade runs against a staged copy/snapshot when rollback requires preserving previous schema/state.
Original last-known-good state remains intact until new revision passes health validation and switch protocol reaches committed boundary.
MigrationOnCopy.Rule: Destructive migration without rollback path requires explicit policy and cannot be the default M0.7 upgrade mechanism.
Failed staged migration cannot alter current installation state.

HealthValidation.Purpose: Prove staged revision sufficiently healthy before switch.
HealthValidation.Requirement: Health probe has deadline and resource budget.
HealthValidation.Invariant: Passing health validation grants no additional authority.
HealthValidation.Rule: Optional capability degradation is represented explicitly rather than automatically failing whole host if composition policy permits it.

AtomicSwitch.Requirement: Switch from previous revision to staged revision has one durable committed active-revision decision.
Crash before committed switch recovers previous Current revision.
Crash after committed switch recovers new Current revision or an explicit rollback-required state; never two authoritative Current revisions.
Provider registry never exposes both old and new revision accidentally under single-provider semantics.

Rollback.Requirement: Rollback creates fresh runtime identity and fresh live authority.
Rollback.Invariant: Runtime grants from failed candidate are never inherited by rollback runtime.
Rollback does not resurrect old RuntimeId or stale handles.
Rollback.Requirement: Failed rollback enters explicit recovery-required state.

PostSwitchObservationWindow.Purpose: Detect immediate failure after technically successful switch.
PostSwitchObservationWindow.Rule: Host composition policy may trigger automatic rollback during bounded validation window.
Automatic rollback threshold is deterministic/configured and observable.

SafeMode.Purpose: Boot a minimal known-good composition when normal composition cannot become healthy.

Requirements.Requirement: Safe mode does not automatically activate optional third-party plugins.
Persistent user/plugin data is not deleted.
Safe mode does not bypass capability authorization.
Disabled/quarantined plugins and reasons are observable.

SafeMode.Clarification: M0.7 safe mode may be headless/CLI/diagnostic-host level. M1 may later surface it graphically.

Quarantine.Requirement: Quarantine state is persistent across host restart.
Quarantine has reason, timestamp/sequence and originating revision.
Quarantine prevents automatic activation but not inspection/removal/ explicit recovery.
Quarantine.Invariant: Quarantine is per installation/revision according to recorded reason; it is not a global ban on PluginDefinition without explicit policy.

AutomatedBisect.Purpose: Identify likely offending optional installation/revision when composition fails.

Requirements.Requirement: Operates only on bounded candidate set.
Result includes tested set and evidence.

AutomatedBisect.Rule: Bisect may disable subsets of optional plugins and re-run health proof.
Multiple interacting failures may yield Inconclusive rather than invented single culprit.

OperationalMetrics.Invariant: Operational metrics do not contain raw private RPC/event/state payload.
OperationalMetrics.Rule: Metrics are diagnostic observations and do not become security decisions unless explicit policy consumes them.

DiagnosticCausality.Purpose: Reconstruct bounded "why did this happen?" chain.
DiagnosticCausality.Query:
Given: EventId / InvocationId / RuntimeId / CorrelationId
return ordered relevant causal facts: admission -> provider selection -> invocation -> state/outbox change -> observation -> lifecycle/crash/restart -> follow-up action
DiagnosticCausality.Requirement: Diagnostic chain uses existing correlation/causation metadata.
It does not invent causal edges merely from close timestamps.
Missing/pruned evidence appears explicitly as gap.
Query never exposes payloads/authority beyond caller diagnostic permission.

SideEffectOutcome.Meaning: Host has durable evidence that an external action may have started, but after crash/disconnect cannot prove whether the remote side effect occurred.
SideEffectOutcome.Invariant: Incomplete external action is not automatically retried unless operation contract proves retry/idempotency safe.
SideEffectOutcome.Requirement: Incomplete outcome carries CorrelationId/InvocationId and diagnostic reason.

ReplayPolicy.Invariant: No global replay engine is introduced.
ReplayPolicy.Rule: Domain may expose deterministic replay only if its ADR explicitly selected event sourcing.
Installation state, outbox, jobs and other non-event-sourced domains recover from their authoritative stores.
ReplayPolicy.Requirement: Diagnostics may replay recorded facts for visualization without treating that as authoritative state reconstruction.

ResolverProperties.Property: provider selection is deterministic for identical inputs/state
adding an irrelevant incompatible provider does not change valid selected provider
authority does not affect compatibility classification
runtime replacement never revives old RuntimeId authority

UpgradeProperties.Property: exactly one active revision after recoverable switch
failed pre-switch validation preserves previous revision

Fuzzing.Invariant: Arbitrary fuzz input must not panic privileged host code.
Fuzzing.Requirement: Reproducible corpus/seed is preserved for discovered failures.

ChaosSuite.Requirement: Recovery occurs in a fresh host process against persistent state.
Chaos tests assert exact post-crash authoritative revision/state.
Tests never pass merely because host can boot; they verify no dual-current revision, authority leakage or lost committed state.

CompatibilityFixtures.Requirement: Repository contains fixtures representing supported prior SDK/protocol versions.
Fixture metadata includes exact historical contract/protocol version.
CompatibilityFixtures.Rule: Stable fixture may be a small reference package rather than whole historical Worldline checkout.
N-1/N-2 support becomes a real promise only for versions for which fixtures exist and CI remains green.

RequiredTests.Test: Stable compatible minor provider works with unchanged consumer.
Stable incompatible major is rejected before activation.
Experimental unsupported revision is rejected explicitly.
Compatibility classification grants no authority.
SDK N/N-1/N-2 designated fixtures pass supported current kernel matrix.
Current SDK fixture rejects unsupported historical kernel baseline cleanly.
Staged revision has no provider publication before switch.
Failed migration-on-copy preserves current state and revision.
Failed health validation preserves current revision.
Successful staged update atomically changes active package revision.
New revision receives fresh RuntimeId.
New revision inherits no old runtime grants.
Crash before switch restores old Current revision.
Crash during switch yields exactly one recoverable Current revision.
Post-switch health failure can trigger rollback.
Rollback restores last-known-good package/state.
Rollback creates fresh RuntimeId and no stale authority.
Crash during rollback remains explicitly recoverable.
Repeated broken optional plugin enters quarantine.
Quarantined plugin does not auto-activate after restart.
Quarantine leaves installation state inspectable/intact.
Safe mode boots without quarantined optional plugins.
Safe mode still enforces capability authorization.
Broken optional plugin does not prevent independent capability subgraph.
Automated bisect identifies single deterministic offending optional plugin.
Interacting failures may return Inconclusive rather than false culprit.
Runtime metrics observe activation/crash/denial/mailbox state without raw payload.
Correlation diagnostic reconstructs known causal chain.
Missing causal record is represented as diagnostic gap.
Crash after external side-effect dispatch but before outcome acknowledgement becomes Incomplete.
Incomplete unsafe operation is not automatically retried.
Event-sourced replay is unavailable for domain without explicit ADR choice.
Resolver property suite passes generated provider/version combinations.
Manifest/IPC/version fuzz targets have no privileged panic for corpus.
Cross-runtime/revoked authority negative suite remains green.
Process-kill chaos suite preserves state/authority/revision invariants.
Existing S0 and S1 proving slices remain green.
Builtin/native/WASM external reference conformance remains green.
Existing M0.1-M0.6 acceptance suites remain green.

StaticArchitectureChecks.Requirement: Compatibility/update code does not import browser/agent/UI domain types.
Upgrade manager does not bypass plugin runtime lifecycle.
Upgrade manager does not mutate StateBackend internals directly outside declared persistence transaction APIs.
Safe mode does not contain special-case browser/agent family branches.
Compatibility resolver and capability authorization remain distinct.
Diagnostic subsystem cannot call arbitrary capabilities merely because it can observe their metadata.

CIIntegration.Invariant: Existing stable repository-owned suites remain the orchestration contract.

Mapping.Suite: compatibility matrix, upgrade state machine, rollback and property tests.
negative host-function/authority tests, safe-mode isolation and static boundary checks.
staged upgrade/rollback/crash proving scenarios plus existing S0/S1.

CIIntegration.Requirement: Expensive fuzz/chaos repetitions may run in deep/nightly CI, but a bounded deterministic smoke subset MUST remain in required repository verification.

ImplementationGuidance.Guidance: Do not begin by creating an updater/downloader.
First implement local immutable package revision upgrade semantics.

Separate: compatibility decision, state staging, health validation, active revision switch, rollback.
Do not hide all five in one update() function.
Do not migrate the only copy of production state before health proof.
Do not implement rollback by "run reverse migration and hope". Preserve a validated rollback source.
Do not make safe mode synonymous with "security disabled".
Do not use timestamps alone to infer causality; reuse M0.4 correlation/causation graph.
Do not create universal deterministic replay machinery.
Operational telemetry belongs to generic runtime/plugin identity, not browser-specific concepts.

Keep Cordis-rs lineage documentation explicit: lifecycle/effect ownership is ancestry, while external compatibility, upgrade transactionality, persistent package revisions and crash rollback are Worldline contracts.

SuggestedExecutionOrder.Step: Inventory current package/protocol/capability version metadata and runtime quarantine/restart facilities.
Write ADR and freeze Stable/Experimental compatibility rules.
Implement staged package revision storage without activation.
Add crash tests around each switch boundary.
Harden persistent quarantine and generic safe mode.
Add fuzz targets and negative security corpus.
Route bounded required subset through repository-owned CI.
Run full M0 regression: S0/S1 + builtin/native/WASM + persistence recovery.
Update GRACE and ROADMAP to M0 Done only after evidence passes.

ReviewQuestions.Question: Может ли staged revision получить provider authority до switch?
Может ли failed migration испортить единственную current state copy?
Есть ли в любой момент два authoritative Current revisions?
Может ли rollback воскресить RuntimeId/grant/handle старого runtime?
Совместимость и authority где-нибудь смешаны?
Может ли package объявить себя Stable и обойти compatibility rules?
Реально ли N-1/N-2 проверяется historical fixture, а не current recompilation?
Safe mode уменьшает composition или случайно отключает security?
Quarantine удаляет данные?
Может ли bisect ошибочно заявить одного виновника при interaction failure?
Содержит ли metrics/diagnostics private payload?
Выводится ли causality из реальных IDs, а не соседства timestamps?
Может ли crash-неопределённый внешний side effect стать Succeeded?
Может ли Incomplete unsafe operation автоматически retry?
Не появился ли global replay/event-sourcing engine "для удобства"?

FailureConditions.Failure: Несовместимый update обнаруживается только после active switch.
Failed staged migration повреждает last-known-good state.
Upgrade может оставить две authoritative active revisions.
Stable compatibility существует только как документация без executable fixtures.
Unknown external outcome маркируется success/failure без evidence.
Generic replay reconstructs non-event-sourced domain state.
Broken optional plugin делает весь host необратимо нерабочим.

ExitCriteria.Criterion: Stable/Experimental capability compatibility semantics are explicit, executable and versioned.
Supported N/N-1/N-2 compatibility fixtures pass CI.
Incompatible upgrade is rejected before switch.
Staged update migrates copied state and validates health before becoming authoritative.
Active revision switch is crash-recoverable and atomic.
Last-known-good rollback restores package/state without restoring stale runtime authority.
Repeated broken plugin is quarantined without destroying unrelated composition or installation state.
Safe mode can boot a minimal generic host composition with security intact.
Operational metrics and causal diagnostics explain runtime failures without exposing raw sensitive payloads.
Unknown external side-effect outcome is represented explicitly as Incomplete.
S0/S1, persistence recovery and builtin/native/WASM conformance remain green.
M0 exit criteria from ROADMAP are all evidenced.
ROADMAP can mark M0.7 Done and M0 complete.
Worldline is ready to begin M1.1 Browser Contract and Engine Spike without another kernel identity/authority/persistence/external-ABI redesign.
